scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/engine && npm run build --workspace=packages/content && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/web/out','out',{recursive:true}); if(process.env.VERCEL){ fs.cpSync('apps/web/out','public',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/web/out','apps/web/public',{recursive:true}); }"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/engine && npm run test --workspace=packages/content
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/content && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=packages/engine && npm run lint --workspace=packages/content && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
